start: Menu, 'Invite members', gym with the member app on

steps.action: Open 'Invite members'
user_sees: Title 'Invite members', line 'Send your gym’s link on WhatsApp, or put a QR poster at the front desk.', button 'Back to Settings'
Card 'Your gym’s link' with app.mettleup.fit/j/<CODE> and the buttons 'Send on WhatsApp', 'Copy link', 'Copy message'
'The message members get' with the full words, and 'To invite one member, open them in Members and tap “Share app link”.'
must_not: Another gym's code in the link
The check-in link (/c/) in place of the invite link

steps.action: Tap 'Send on WhatsApp'
user_sees: WhatsApp opens in a new tab with the message typed in: 'Hi!', 'Join <gym> in the MettleUp app: track your workouts and order from the gym shop.', 'Tap to join:', the link, 'Gym code: <CODE>'; WhatsApp asks who to send it to
must_not: A message sent to anyone before the person picks who and presses send in WhatsApp
A number already filled in
The link glued to other words so WhatsApp does not make it tappable

start: Invite members page (other ways to share: copy)

steps.action: Tap 'Copy link'
user_sees: A short note 'Link copied.'
must_not: The note shown when nothing was copied

steps.action: Tap 'Copy message' in a browser that blocks copying
user_sees: The note 'This browser blocked copying. Select the text and copy it.'
must_not: 'Message copied.' shown when the copy was blocked

start: Invite members page (another kind: the front-desk QR poster)

steps.action: Look at the card 'Front-desk QR poster'
user_sees: The poster with the gym name, logo if any, a QR of the invite link and the gym code
must_not: The check-in poster's words on the join poster

steps.action: Tap 'Print poster', then 'Download picture'
user_sees: The print page with only the poster; then the note 'Poster saved as a picture.' (or 'Could not make the picture. Try Print poster.')
Hint 'Print it on A4 and stick it at the desk. On a phone, Print → “Save as PDF” also works. Use the picture for a print shop.'
must_not: The rest of the page on the paper
A picture without the QR

start: A gym-code card elsewhere in the panel (Settings, or 'Invite & QR poster' links from Check-in QR, Messages, What's new, the new-gym sheet, quick action 'Invite poster')

steps.action: On the gym-code card tap 'Copy code'
user_sees: The button reads 'Copied ✓' for about 3 seconds
must_not: 'Copied ✓' when the browser refused; then it must say 'This browser blocked copying. The code is selected. Press Ctrl+C to copy it.'

steps.action: Tap 'Send link on WhatsApp', then 'Invite & QR poster'
user_sees: WhatsApp opens with the same invite message; then the Invite members page opens
must_not: A different message or link than the Invite members page sends

start: Invite members page of a gym that has not turned on the member app

steps.action: Open 'Invite members'
user_sees: Card 'Let members order from your gym in the MettleUp app.' with the button 'Turn on the shop'
must_not: A link or QR with an empty code
A blank page

steps.action: Tap 'Turn on the shop' with the internet off
user_sees: The button reads 'Turning on…', then a red line with the reason; the button can be pressed again
must_not: A gym code shown though nothing was made
A button stuck on 'Turning on…'
Two gyms made by a second tap

start: Invite members page before and after the member app is on

steps.action: Before: open the page and turn on the shop
user_sees: Before: the 'not turned on' card. After the owner turns it on: the link, the message and the poster with the new gym code
must_not: The old card still shown after the app is on
A code that changes each time the page opens

steps.action: Send the link, then come back another day
user_sees: The same link and code
must_not: A changed link that breaks the messages and posters already out

start: Invite members page, signed in as owner

steps.action: Read the message and the QR
user_sees: Only the gym's name, its link and its gym code
must_not: A member's name or number
The gym's sign-in key
A claim the panel sent the message: it is sent from the person's own WhatsApp

steps.action: Think of who can use the link
user_sees: Anyone who gets the link or the code can join the gym in the app and then shows under 'Joined in the app'
must_not: A joined stranger shown as a paying member of the gym without the desk adding them
